description:
**Project Role :** 
 Quality Engineering Lead
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Leads a team of quality engineers through multi\-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Applies business and functional knowledge to develop end\-to\-end testing strategies through the use of quality processes and methodologies. Applies testing methodologies, principles and processes to define and implement key metrics to manage and assess the testing process including test execution and defect resolution.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 FIS Commercial Loan Servicing (ACBS)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Finastra Fusion Loan IQ
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Quality Engineering Lead, you will lead a team of quality engineers, guiding them through the complexities of multi\-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration. Your typical day will involve collaborating with various stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high\-quality applications, while applying your expertise in quality processes and methodologies to enhance the testing lifecycle. You will focus on developing comprehensive testing strategies that align with business objectives, ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the application development process. Your role will also include monitoring key metrics to assess the effectiveness of testing efforts and driving continuous improvement initiatives within the team.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Contribute to migration activities from legacy lending platforms to CLS – validation of solutions in CLS core product and peripheral systems as applicable
* Collaborate with SMEs \& BAs to test mapping rules and logic for migration
* Test the migration loading to CLS in a controlled environment to refine the process of executing all defined activities required for the data migration
* Support operations teams for data review and enrichments
* Define and perform end to end dress rehearsals and production migration
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and completeness during the migration lifecycle
* Defect management and reporting


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* The position requires a 6\-8 years of relevant software testing experience, with hands\-on experience on Commercial Lending Solution (CLS) or ACBS, or any other equivalent platform
* Domain \& Product knowledge: Structured Finance. Expertise in Commercial Lending domain, with hands\-on experience on FIS Commercial Lending Solutions (CLS) or ACBS or any other equivalent platform
* Test Management: Proficiency in designing, executing test cases, both manually, and using automated tools, to verify that the software behaves as expected by users.
* Data Analysis: Proficiency in tools like SQL, Excel, data visualization software (e.g. PowerBI) for extracting insights from large datasets.
* Data Migration: Hands\-on experience on any ETL tool – (Not mandatory)
* Software Development Lifecycle: Strong understanding of SDLC
* Advanced communication skills: ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders, present findings, and write functional/technical documentation.
* Stakeholder s management: ability to identify, analyze, and manage the expectations and requirements of stakeholders. Establish and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders to ensure their support and cooperation.
* Agile methodologies: understanding of agile frameworks like Scrum or Kanban and related project management tools (JIRA).
* Behavior Driven Development (BDD): Hands\-on experience of frameworks and practices, with experience using Cucumber/Gherkin, and X\-ray tools.
* Critical and analytical thinking: capability to analyze complex business problems, prioritize requirements, and propose innovative solutions.
* System analysis: proficiency for documenting system requirements and workflows, familiarity with documentation system (e.g. confluence, UML ).
* API integration: Understanding of API integration and web services that may be in scope of end\-to\-end testing with external systems.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Finastra Fusion Loan IQ.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: QA Automation Engineer - QA 2
description:
**Job Purpose**
 We are looking for a QA2 Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our customer\-facing frontend platforms including Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 The primary focus of this role will be to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for mobile and web platforms. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure that new features are delivered with high quality and minimal regressions.
   

  

 As an e\-commerce platform, our applications power critical user journeys such as product catalogue browsing, checkout flows, payments, and order lifecycle management, and this role will play a key part in ensuring these flows remain stable and reliable.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have a strong understanding of automation frameworks, frontend testing strategies, test design techniques, and CI/CD integration. Experience in mobile and web test automation along with modern QA practices will be highly valuable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and test suites for Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 Write automated test cases for functional, regression, and end\-to\-end testing of customer\-facing features.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with frontend engineers (Android, iOS, Web) to understand application architecture and ensure proper automation coverage.
   

  

 Validate critical e\-commerce user journeys including product discovery, checkout flows, payment flows, and order lifecycle.
   

  

 Design and execute test scenarios using strong test design techniques such as boundary value testing, equivalence partitioning, and risk\-based testing.
   

  

 Manage and track test cases, test execution, and defects using Jira and related test management practices.
   

  

 Work closely with product managers and designers to validate business requirements and ensure correct feature behavior.
   

  

 Perform API testing and validation to ensure reliability of frontend\-backend integrations.
   

  

 Build and maintain automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD systems to enable continuous testing.
   

  

 Identify defects, analyze root causes, and collaborate with developers to ensure faster resolution.
   

  

 Monitor automation results and improve stability, reliability, and execution efficiency of automation suites.
   

  

 Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to improve the overall QA automation ecosystem.
   

  

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release readiness discussions.
   

  

 Ensure high standards for performance, reliability, and usability across devices and browsers.
   

  

**Skills \& Requirements**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 3–5 years of experience in QA Automation, preferably testing mobile and web applications.
   

  

 Experience working with test management tools such as Jira for test case management and defect tracking.
   

  

**Hands\-on Experience With Automation Tools Such As**
* Appium / Espresso / XCUITest for mobile automation
* Selenium / Playwright / Cypress for web automation


 Experience writing automation tests using Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, or Python.
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of Test Design Techniques Such As**
* Boundary value analysis
* Equivalence partitioning
* Risk\-based testing


 Experience with API testing tools and frameworks such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar.
   

  

 Good understanding of mobile and web application architecture and frontend workflows.
   

  

 Experience integrating automation test suites with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
   

  

 Proficiency with Git or similar code versioning tools.
   

  

 Experience testing REST APIs and JSON\-based services.
   

  

 Strong analytical and debugging skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced Agile development environment.
   

  

**Good To Have**
 Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber / Gherkin.
   

  

 Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6\.
   

  

 Experience with mobile device farms such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.
   

  

 Understanding of mobile deep linking, push notifications, and analytics validation.
   

  

 Experience with test reporting tools such as Allure or ReportPortal.
   

  

 Understanding of modern frontend technologies and mobile architectures.

title: Automation Engineer - Digital Process Automation (DPA)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Automation Engineer \- Digital Process Automation (DPA)**
 The Workflow Automation team focuses on eliminating manual friction and accelerating business outcomes through intelligent process orchestration. We operate in a fast\-paced Agile environment, utilizing cutting\-edge Low\-Code and DPA platforms to build the "digital glue" that connects Roche’s enterprise systems.
   

  

 As a
 **Workflow Automation Engineer** 
 , you will be responsible for the technical design, development, and maintenance of high\-scale automation solutions at Roche. You will work closely with the Product Owner and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical implementations. Ensuring that our digital workflows are performant, scalable, and integrated seamlessly with our global IT ecosystem, you will serve as a hands\-on expert in driving our digital transformation forward.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Engineer End\-to\-End Workflows: Design and develop complex automation workflows using the Pega platform or similar technologies to eliminate manual friction
* Solve Technical Challenges: Take ownership of tasks within the "grey zone," troubleshooting complex integration issues and optimizing system performance for high reliability
* Bridge Systems via Integration: Design and maintain secure REST/SOAP API integrations between the DPA platform and diverse internal or external data sources
* Drive Operational Excellence: Monitor production processes to identify bottlenecks and implement continuous improvements and performance tuning
* Collaborate in Agile Squads: Actively participate in Scrum/Kanban ceremonies, refining technical stories and providing accurate estimates to ensure timely delivery
* Ensure Security Compliance: Build solutions that strictly adhere to Roche’s global security and data privacy standards through clean and maintainable configurations
* Mentor and Share Knowledge: Act as a technical bridge within your squad by participating in peer code reviews and sharing expertise during "Tech Talks."
* Document Technical Architecture: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including low\-level designs and deployment guides for long\-term scalability


**Who You Are**
* Experienced Software Engineer: You bring approximately 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years specifically focused on DPA or BPM platforms
* Certified Pega Expert: You hold a mandatory Pega Senior System Architect (CSSA) certification or possess equivalent expertise in platforms like Appian or Camunda
* Integration Specialist: You have a solid understanding of web services, microservices architecture, and JSON/XML data structures to connect enterprise ecosystems
* Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field that provides a strong technical foundation
* Agile Contributor: You have a proven track record of delivering medium\-to\-large scale technical initiatives within Agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban
* Standards\-Driven Developer: You are experienced with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated testing frameworks relevant to DPA platforms
* Strategic Communicator: You possess the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively in global, distributed teams


**Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.**
**\#RDT2026**
 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
